title: 北魏洛阳盛时复原：来源图地理骨架与证据
geometry_format_note: Geometry objects use GeoJSON geometry structure but coordinates remain Xian 1980. This collection is not RFC7946 WGS84 GeoJSON and must not be silently read as EPSG:4326.

summary.core_result: 已从公开申遗原图的可读经纬网取得有来源、可重算的内城/宫城/金墉丙城/永宁寺/道路骨架。地面绝对误差和古地形仍未实地核验。

sources.title: Management Plan for Site of Luoyang City from the Eastern Han to Northern Wei Dynasty (2012–2018), drawing 06a
sources.source_type: State Party World Heritage nomination dossier; institutional primary management map
sources.printed_identifier: 06a (standalone drawing, no printed running page number)
sources.publisher_host: UNESCO World Heritage Centre; nomination content supplied by States Parties
sources.rights_note: Only factual geographic observations and a limited derived research geometry set are retained. Raw dossier, map image, text facsimile and basemap are not republished.

reference_point.role: component registration point; not used as a ground control or ancient site center

calibration.datum: Xian 1980 (1980西安坐标系), explicitly printed on map
calibration.vertical_datum: 1985 National Height Datum, explicitly printed; no height values extracted
calibration.original_map_projection_note: 图注未给出投影名称/带号，本次直接按经纬刻度拟合；不擅自声称原图是某一高斯—克吕格分带。
calibration.fit_method: Independent least-squares affine fits for longitude and latitude to 8 edge-axis constraints each, total16 printed graticule ticks. PDF vector positions, not OCR or label centroids.
calibration.control_status: All controls are map-graticule constraints, not ground-survey GCPs.
calibration.accuracy_note: Fit residuals test internal reproduction of printed graticule only; they do not establish archaeological feature accuracy or valid transformation to WGS84/CGCS2000.

vector_extraction.method: Page.get_drawings(); zero-based drawing indices and seqno stored per feature
vector_extraction.source_vertices: PDF point units with original top-left origin; corresponding 1800px page render vertices retained
vector_extraction.feature_source_mapping: Drawing04 (PDF3455) and Annex II-F pp1–7 identify names, source codes, periods; selected geometry is taken from Drawing06a (PDF3457).

rendering_rules: 遗址骨架和现代地理参照分别开关；现代洛水与邙山方位显示明确时层。
宫城北缘派生闭合线使用推定样式；内城南墙和宣阳门保持未知。
建筑符号只用中心定位，不能直接拉伸为三维实体；尺寸另据附表或文献。
外郭相关遗存边界不得画成连续精测城墙，也不得据此填满全部坊里。
与现代WGS84 DSM/影像叠合前须另验证坐标转换；不在本版执行。
全景采用相同来源布局骨架；建筑高度/密度/天际线另列复原假设，不能借地图坐标为未证形制背书。

entity_binding_summary.rule: 只绑定已逐名、角色、方位核对的门和明确组成部分；范围与道路仅相关或候选连接，不修改旧实体几何。
entity_binding_summary.unbound_taiji_and_yunlong: 现有entities未收同名明确实体，不为迁就连接而新建或强绑。
